obligation: G032 -- does the fold survive the norm being quantized, as it is in a real artifact?
why: The block-fold receipt used EXACT norms. In the artifact the input_layernorm weight is itself uniform-encoded (codec 3, ~4.65 bits/elem, 2977 bytes for 5120 elements), so the folded g/s is QUANTIZED. Dividing g by s widens its dynamic range, which can cost more than the fold saves. Measuring that is cheaper than packing it.
identity_used: x = rmsnorm(h) * g, so folding gives x' = rmsnorm(h) * Q(g/s) = x * Q(g/s)/g. Exact rewrite -- no pre-norm hidden state needed.
